tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background. Dark is the reference theme; light is warm, never grey-blue.

tokens.name: bg-alt
tokens.usage: Alternate band behind every other landing section, and the app sidebar.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, the inbox and Drive panes of a demo, rows that need a ground.

tokens.name: surface-strong
tokens.usage: A selected tab, a hovered row, a chip.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows and around panels. Decorative, never a control's only edge.

tokens.name: heading
tokens.usage: Headlines and names of things.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body text on bg, bg-alt and surface.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, sources, where something came from. Passes 4.5:1 on every ground.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Bower teal. The bird's body, the primary button fill, Projects. A fill: never text on a light ground.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand fill (9.9:1).

tokens.name: brand-line
tokens.usage: Teal as text, links, focus rings and strokes. Light uses the darker teal to pass 4.5:1.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Amber. The beak and feet, Areas, highlights. A fill on light; text only on dark.

tokens.name: accent-line
tokens.usage: Amber as text or a stroke: strikethroughs, the focus outline of the landing.

tokens.name: find
tokens.usage: The blue bottle cap: the things Bower collects in the court. Never a UI colour.

tokens.name: para-projects
tokens.usage: Projects: things with an end. Dot, folder and chip colour.

tokens.name: para-areas
tokens.usage: Areas: things that go on.

tokens.name: para-resources
tokens.usage: Resources: for later. Also 'from the web' in Bower's notes.

tokens.name: para-archive
tokens.usage: Archive: done. Also 'from your notes and the web'.

tokens.name: bird-body
tokens.usage: Bower's body and head. The bird keeps its colours in both themes.

tokens.name: bird-wing
tokens.usage: Wing and tail feathers.

tokens.name: bird-belly
tokens.usage: Belly patch.

tokens.name: bird-beak
tokens.usage: Upper beak and legs.

tokens.name: bird-jaw
tokens.usage: Lower beak (the jaw that opens).

tokens.name: bird-iris
tokens.usage: Iris. Sits on a white eye and moves to look at things.

tokens.name: bird-iris-ring
tokens.usage: The violet ring round the iris, after the satin bowerbird's eye.

tokens.name: bird-blush
tokens.usage: Cheek blush at 55% opacity. Left out of the logo.

tokens.name: twig
tokens.usage: The bower's twigs (with #6b4a2e and #b78a58 for depth). Only in the court illustration.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and the 'Delete the app' outline.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Done states.

styles.name: hero
styles.sample: Your Drive, tidied by a bowerbird.
styles.usage: One per page: the landing headline. 44px on a phone.

styles.name: h2
styles.sample: Throw it all in. Tap once.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The wordmark next to the mark. Never set inside running text.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Save photos, PDFs, links and notes as they come.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Bower reads each one, names it and files it in your own Google Drive.
styles.usage: Running text. 17px on a phone. Lines under 70 characters.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons and tabs. Sentence case, never all caps.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Sources, hints, small print, in text-muted.

styles.name: filename
styles.usage: Only for real file names and links as they arrived. Never for labels or data.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chips in a row, buttons in a group.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row padding, gap between a heading and its line.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Phone side gutter, panel padding on a phone.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Desktop side gutter.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Panel padding, gap between a demo's two panes.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Heading block to its demo.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Gap between the two columns of a section.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop (80px on a phone).

tokens.name: radius-row
tokens.usage: Rows that light up, icon tiles, small panes.

tokens.name: radius-skin
tokens.usage: App windows inside a demo.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: The one framed panel of a section. 20px on a phone.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, the New tag.

tokens.name: radius-icon
tokens.usage: App icon and favicon square.
